Qualcomm's own release frames the goal as a silicon-agnostic compute layer across devices, edge and data centers. The prediction's falsifiable bar: at least one rival accelerator buyer (AMD, Intel, or a hyperscaler silicon arm) responds by acquiring or taking a controlling stake in a comparable cross-vendor inference-compiler or runtime startup. The gap to the bar: today supplies the catalyzing Qualcomm-Modular deal that removes the largest neutral compiler asset, but no rival counter-acquisition has been announced.

prediction_ref.short_label: Coding-agent platform ships trifecta capability gate as default by Q1 2027

validation_rows.evidence_summary: Today's security lead is the architectural premise this thesis rests on. The OWASP GenAI Security Project's version 2.01 State of Agentic AI Security and Governance reframes prompt injection from another CVE into a design constraint: it is the universal joint connecting most agentic-AI incidents and now maps to six of the ten categories in OWASP's Top 10 for Agentic Applications. Because a model treats system prompt, user request and retrieved text as one undifferentiated token stream, there is no reliable way to mark tokens as commands versus data, so the flaw is mitigated by design budgets, not patched -- the report leans on Simon Willison's lethal trifecta and Meta's Agents Rule of Two. Crucially, it names coding agents the epicenter: 28 of 53 tracked agentic projects are coding agents, with the most-advisoried repositories being n8n (57), Claude Code (22), AutoGPT (15), Dify (13) and Roo-Code (11). The prediction's falsifiable bar: at least one leading coding-agent platform ships a default-on capability gate enforcing a Rule-of-Two constraint -- at most two of private-data access, untrusted-content exposure, and external communication before pausing for human approval. The gap to the bar: today supplies the unpatchable-by-design argument and the epicenter naming, but no platform has shipped a default-on trifecta gate.
